manager.findings: This ten-trade group lost $2.20974403 after costs, with zero winners. Gross was down 11.28 basis points and commissions cost another 10.61 basis points of entry notional. Two READY and eight WAIT trades lost money. The recorded gross price loss persisted across the coin mix. The first 140 positions cover 44 source baskets. Current review evidence supports prospectively testing whether a breakout remains above its reference high at the time of the executable quote.
manager.recommendation: Retain three contracts, the ten-minute hold and the frozen four-READY test. In separate prospective research, record closed-bar excess over the prior high, quote spread and age, and the pre-submit midpoint relative to that high. Evaluate after-cost continuation using signals available before order submission, and measure fill retention, guarded entries and no-fills as outcomes. Compare matched baskets and days and include opportunities skipped by a proposed rule.

ceo.rationale: The measured longer holds worsened on their available pairs and the reviewed entry signals came from three related baskets. Keep the frozen protocol and agreed limits while gathering independent evidence on executable breakout continuation.
